_description: A Bash permission request (options allow-once 'Yes', allow-with-updates 'Yes, and don't ask again for latexmk commands', reject 'No', as the real adapter sends them). The default accepts any answer; prompts containing 'once', 'always' or 'reject' fail the turn unless that option is chosen. 'plan' sends the adapter's ExitPlanMode options (Lemma offers only exit-plan-default and reject).

default.say: I need to run latexmk to see the full bibliography warnings.

once.say: I need to run latexmk once.

always.say: I need to run latexmk, possibly several times.
Allowed for the rest of the session.

reject.say: I would like to delete the build directory.
Understood, I will not delete anything.

plan.say: Here is my plan: tighten the abstract, then compile.
